description:
so my room is a repurposed garage and now the poor plumbing gave it an ammonia leak, you may notice i didn't do anything for the last 2 weeks- IT'S BECAUSE OF AMMONIA POISONINGGGG

this song is a double entendre for a toxic social or corporate power dynamics 
the ammonia is toxic friends/workmates

fun fact: the "pshh" gas leak sound you hear at the start is actually my 12 inch duct fan blowing out air from this room just so i could survive from ammonia the fan is so loud help

fun fact 2: ammonia is hydrophilic (attracted to water), which is why i tried to sound dry at the chorus XDD ammonia can suck water out of you and make you drown on land did you know that no wayyyyy

locked in making a song about ammonia named locked in ammonia while locked in a room with ammonia is truly an experience

I cannot believe i made this entire thing, from instrumental, lyrics, vocals, to mixing to this video all while suffering in ammonia wowowowa

i'm going to move out of here in about 2 weeks, till then i might not produce more songs because i am locked in ammonia in ammonia locked in qwq

aaaaaa

join the discord:
https://discord.gg/yW9bjA9nKF
we have a temporary ammonia gas chamber there (it will disappear once i move out)

links to this song here:
https://distrokid.com/hyperfollow/oricade/locked-in-ammonia

lyrics, vocal, musical arrangement, and video by @Oricade 
I'm not that good in mixing and mastering and i'm still learning!
